interpretation: On the same PHY2/CSID3 configuration, front-camera preview repeatedly produced frames with only raw PHY status word 6 equal to 0x1. The iris run produced raw status 0x4 on its configured upper pair (words 3 and 4) and 0x10 in word 6, but no CSID packets, ECC or CRC. The lane-specific status difference confirms the receiver observed different raw PHY events during the iris attempt; the event bit meanings are not decoded, so this does not establish a valid MIPI stream. CAMSS TOP values were already at the Windows-noted target (0x40=0x30, 0x44=0x03). The test narrows the issue to PHY event interpretation/PHY-to-CSID acceptance or the sensor's emitted signal, without distinguishing these causes.
